offer-poster-maker: Choose Instagram post (square or portrait), a story for Instagram or WhatsApp status, or A4 for a printed pamphlet. The story size keeps text away from the areas Instagram covers with its own buttons.
Many designs with different colours and fonts are shown with your own details, so you can compare them side by side. Tap one to use it. You can change your mind at any time.
Fill in the top and bottom

Type the shop name, one big heading such as DIWALI SALE or NEW STOCK, a small line under it, and a corner badge such as UP TO 30% OFF, FLAT 200 OFF or just words. Add your WhatsApp number, Facebook page name and Instagram ID at the bottom. Anything you leave empty is left out. Your details are remembered in this browser.
Choose how many products and edit them

Pick 2, 4, 6, 9, 12 or 15 products: fewer products get bigger photos. For each, change the name, old price, new price and photo, and edit the badge on the photo (a percentage, an amount or words). Choose whether photos or text get more room. Leave a name, price or badge empty to hide it.
Check the preview, then download. Post it on Instagram or Facebook, send it on WhatsApp, or print the A4 version and put it up in the shop.

offerPosterMakerGuide.title: Offer Poster Maker: Sale Posters for Instagram, WhatsApp and Print
offerPosterMakerGuide.subtitle: Add your shop name, product photos, old and new prices and contact details, pick a design and download a PNG for Instagram, WhatsApp or print. Free, no watermark.
faq: Is it free, and is there a watermark?
Yes, free with no account and no watermark on the picture.
Are my photos and prices uploaded?
No. Photos, prices and contact details are used only inside your browser, and the poster is created there. Nothing is sent to MyDailyUtils.
Which size should I use for Instagram?
Use the square post for the feed grid, the portrait post for the most screen space in the feed, and the story size for stories, reels covers and WhatsApp status. A4 is for printing.
Why do the Facebook and Instagram names not open when I tap them?

A PNG picture cannot contain a working link. The poster shows your Facebook page name and Instagram ID so people can search for you. Put the full links in the caption or comments of your post, where they can be tapped.
Why is some space at the top and bottom of the story size empty?
Instagram places your profile name at the top and the reply bar at the bottom of a story. The poster keeps names, prices and contact details clear of those areas so nothing is hidden.
How is the discount badge decided?

Each product's badge starts as the percentage worked out from its old and new price, for example 699 to 499 gives 29% OFF. You can type anything instead, such as 200 OFF, Buy 1 Get 1 or NEW, or clear it to hide the badge. The corner badge at the top starts as UP TO and your biggest discount and can be changed or cleared in the same way.
Can I use Hindi or other languages?

Yes. Names, headings and lines can be typed in any language your keyboard supports. Hindi text is shown in a clear fallback font. Some of the decorative display fonts are Latin-only, so a Hindi heading may look plainer in those designs.
Why do my photos look cropped?
Photos fill their box. Use Adjust photo to zoom or move the picture, or tick Show the whole photo to fit it without cropping.
What currency can I use?
Any. Prices are plain numbers with no currency symbol, so the poster suits any country. Add a symbol yourself in the price field if you want one.
Can I use the photos in the examples?
The example photos are from Pexels and are only there to show the designs. Replace them with pictures of your own products before you post.

sections.heading: What the Offer Poster Maker is for
paragraphs: A small shop does not need a designer to announce a sale. A clear picture with the shop name, a few products, the old price crossed out and the new price beside it, and a way to contact you is usually all that customers look at on a phone. This tool builds that picture from a form, in a few minutes, using layouts and colours chosen to look like the promotions people already see on shopping apps, Instagram and Facebook.
You fill in your details, pick from many designs, add your own product photos and download a PNG. The same poster can be made as an Instagram post, a story or an A4 page for the shop wall.

sections.heading: Choosing a size
paragraphs: The square post works everywhere in the feed. The portrait post takes up more of the screen on a phone and is a good choice when you have six to nine products. The story size is taller, and leaves clear space at the top and bottom so Instagram's own profile bar and reply field do not cover your text. The A4 size has more room for products and prints sharply on an ordinary home or shop printer.

With one to three products the photos are very large. With more, they pack into a neat grid. You can choose 2, 4, 6, 9, 12 or 15 products, and you can tell the poster to give more room to the photos, to the text, or a balance of both.

sections.heading: Writing a poster that sells
paragraphs: Keep the big heading short, such as SALE, WEEKEND OFFER or DIWALI DHAMAKA. Use the line under the shop name for the date or condition, for example offers valid till Sunday. Put the product people ask about most first, because the first photo is the biggest in some designs.

Use a photo taken in daylight against a plain background. Photos are cropped to fit, so keep the product in the middle, and use Adjust photo if something is cut off. Enter the real old price and the new price, and the discount badge is calculated for you, so the numbers on the poster always agree.

sections.heading: Posting and printing
paragraphs: Download the PNG, then upload it to Instagram or Facebook, or send it in a WhatsApp group or status. Put your WhatsApp number on the poster so people can message you directly. For a printed pamphlet choose A4 and print at actual size on plain or glossy paper.
The picture is a normal PNG with no watermark. Because it is created on your device, you can make as many versions as you like, for example one per festival, and download each.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Your photos, prices and contact details never leave your browser. The poster is drawn on your device and the PNG is created there, so nothing is uploaded to MyDailyUtils. The design fonts are part of the site itself, so no other service is contacted.
